selectionMethod: highest-impact repeated suspicious access location in the current full audit; all shared route occurrences reviewed together

selectedLocations.name: Good Hope Access
selectedLocations.rationale: The current PFBC-verified GIS identifies Good Hope as a PFBC-owned access area on Conodoguinet Creek and publishes point geometry. The previous coordinate was a road-address geocode. Cumberland County's updated guide confirms public unpowered-boat access and a shallow ramp with a short carry and slope to water; no surveyed wet-edge coordinate was found.
